definitions.offeredRenewal: Sum of the nine patch renewal requests for each completed live tick, using recipe.foodRenewal and renewalMultiplier; it excludes ticks after extinction. Realized renewal is the per-interval ledger.renewed delta. Ratio is realized/offered and can be below one when stock is at capacity.
definitions.familyRange: Per-family minima and maxima include tick zero and update after every tick, including the exact first-zero tick. First loss is the first exact tick a previously present family reaches zero.
definitions.sampledRebounds: One episode starts at a sampled census with 1–9 members and ends at a later sampled census with at least 20. Episodes for a family do not overlap; zero cancels a pending episode. Exact family loss is measured every tick. These are demographic observations, not fitness or adaptation.
definitions.sampling: Censuses and patch stock are retained at tick zero, every 100 ticks, every exact phase-change tick, and extinction. At a phase boundary, tick k*period (for example 600) closes the ending phase interval; tick k*period+1 (for example 601) is the first step in the new phase and closes its one-tick interval. tickFamilyCounts stores [tick,family0,family1,family2] for every completed tick; each row transitions from the preceding tick row or the initial census.
definitions.accounting: Every tick checks particleEnergy + foodEnergy + dissipated + deathLoss - initial - renewed. Cap ticks count completed ticks at populationMax. Interval offered and realized values, ratio, cap ticks, and maximum absolute residual accompany each sampled interval.
definitions.clocks: Live results stop at extinction; finishedTick is the exact extinction tick or the 10,800 target. Extinct worlds receive no renewal, rescue, or synthetic later samples.
definitions.limits: Descriptive engineered toy only. Within each seed, arms share the same initial state; all arms share phase order and initial stock, with row 0 rich first. The world states of seasonal-600 and seasonal-1800 are bit-identical through tick 600, then diverge at tick 601 when the short-phase arm enters phase 1. Arms diverge in their random trajectories once food changes. Nearest-patch steering ignores stock. No paired significance or adaptation claim.
